title: A session whose work is recorded as done but whose process stays alive is flagged, and stopped after a grace period when the operator's policy allows
goal: backlog.py stalled lists a finished-alive signal for an item whose dispatched worker wrote its result, or whose run is returned or landed, while that worker's own recorded pid still runs past the grace period bl_stall.FINISHED_ALIVE_GRACE_S, read at call time; kbmon's sessions panel and needs-you line show it; when backlog.json's stop_finished setting is true (off by default), dispatch's wait sends SIGTERM to that recorded pid only and records the stop as an ops row; no other process is ever signalled.

run:
import json,os,re,signal,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time,pathlib as P
if os.name=="nt":
    print("check skipped: needs a POSIX host");sys.exit(0)
T=os.path.abspath("_tools");d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp"));rem=d/"remote.git"
s.run(["git","init","-q","--bare","-b","main",str(rem)],check=True)
def clone(name,stop):
    r=d/name;s.run(["git","clone","-q",str(rem),str(r)],check=True,capture_output=True)
    g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
    cfg={"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch","worktree_dir":"wt","forge":"","land_push":["git","push","origin","HEAD:"+name]}
    if stop is not None:cfg["stop_finished"]=stop
    (r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps(cfg))
    (r/"items").mkdir();(r/".gitignore").write_text("_cache/\nwt/\n")
    (r/"items"/"SP-zzstopsp.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id":"SP-zzstopsp","kind":"sprint","title":"s","status":"active","goal":"g"}))
    (r/"x.txt").write_text("x")
    (r/"items"/"ST-zzstopaa.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(id="ST-zzstopaa",kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}],sprint="SP-zzstopsp"),indent=2)+"\n")
    g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i");g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:"+name)
    return r
b=d/"bin";b.mkdir();os.symlink("/bin/sleep",b/"fsleep");FS=str(b/"fsleep")
def end(tag):
    for l in s.run(["ps","-axo","pid=,command="],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines():
        q,_,c=l.strip().partition(" ")
        if c.startswith(tag):
            try:os.kill(int(q),9)
            except (OSError,ValueError):pass
(b/"claude").write_text("#!/bin/sh\ncat >/dev/null\n\"$FSLEEP\" 120 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &\necho $! >\"$KB_DECOY_FILE\"\necho '{\"subtype\":\"success\",\"num_turns\":1,\"total_cost_usd\":0,\"session_id\":\"s1\",\"result\":\"done\"}'\nexec \"$FSLEEP\" 120 </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1\n");os.chmod(b/"claude",0o755)
def alive(pid):
    try:os.kill(pid,0);return True
    except OSError:return False
def run(name,stop,wait):
    r=clone(name,stop);decoy=d/(name+".decoy");p=None;wpid=dpid=None;out=None;ended=False
    env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=str(d/"coord.sqlite"),CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=str(d/(name+"-data")),CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.path.dirname(T),KB_DECOY_FILE=str(decoy),FSLEEP=FS,CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk",PATH=str(b)+os.pathsep+os.environ["PATH"],GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="x",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="x@x",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="x",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="x@x")
    try:
        s.run([sys.executable,T+"/backlog.py","--root",str(r),"claim","ST-zzstopaa","--by","claude-chk"],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
        code="import sys;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]);import bl_stall;bl_stall.FINISHED_ALIVE_GRACE_S=2;import runpy;sys.argv=[sys.argv[1]+'/backlog.py']+sys.argv[2:];runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')"
        p=s.Popen([sys.executable,"-c",code,T,"--root",str(r),"dispatch","ST-zzstopaa"],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.STDOUT,text=True,env=env,start_new_session=True)
        try:out=p.communicate(timeout=wait)[0];ended=True
        except s.TimeoutExpired:pass
        time.sleep(1)
        lf=r/".git"/"kb-backlog-claims.json"
        led=json.loads(lf.read_text()).get("ST-zzstopaa",{}) if lf.exists() else {}
        wpid=led.get("worker_pid");dpid=int(decoy.read_text().strip()) if decoy.exists() and decoy.read_text().strip() else None
        walive=alive(wpid) if wpid else None;dalive=alive(dpid) if dpid else None
    finally:
        for x in (wpid,dpid):
            if x:
                try:os.kill(x,signal.SIGKILL)
                except OSError:pass
        if p is not None:
            try:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
            except OSError:pass
            if out is None:out=p.communicate()[0]
        end(FS)
    ops=s.run([sys.executable,T+"/backlog.py","--root",str(r),"ops","SP-zzstopsp"],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120).stdout
    print(name,"dispatch ended",ended,"worker",wpid,"alive",walive,"decoy alive",dalive,"ops:",ops[-300:],"out:",(out or "")[-500:])
    return ended,walive,dalive,ops
ended,walive,dalive,ops=run("on",True,45)
ok=ended and walive is False and dalive is True and bool(re.search("sigterm|finished",ops,re.I))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: What happens to a worker whose work is recorded as done but whose process is still alive after the grace period?
options: flag it only; the orchestrator or the operator stops it
SIGTERM its own recorded pid when a backlog.json setting allows it, off by default
always SIGTERM its own recorded pid
gates.recommendation: SIGTERM its own recorded pid when a backlog.json setting allows it, off by default
gates.reason: the result is already written, and only the recorded pid is ever signalled
gates.answer: SIGTERM its own recorded pid when a backlog.json setting allows it, off by default

notes: Premise: python3 _tools/backlog.py stalled -h lists no signal for a worker that finished and stays alive; headless claude -p sprint sessions have written their report and final message and then not exited, stalling the next step until stopped by hand. Its JSON output is written on SIGTERM, so stopping the recorded pid loses nothing. Relates to ST-qqeojkym, which counts a worker's cost as closed once its process exits. Plan check 2026-10-26: the old check (stalled --json on this clone) passed before the work and is dropped. Check 0 plants four doing items in a temp clone (result written and pid alive; run returned and pid alive; result written and pid gone; run working) and runs stalled with FINISHED_ALIVE_GRACE_S patched to 1; check 1 reads kbmon --root of that clone (the result is a day old); checks 2-3 dispatch a fake claude that prints its result and stays alive, with stop_finished true and unset, and a decoy child it started: on the base no signal, no stop, no ops row (premise reproduced). The goal names the constant and the setting the operator's gate g1 left to the plan: off by default as answered. Moved out of SP-hxxn6fnv by the unattended orchestrator 2026-10-26: the worker ($1.83) raised three gates of class agents-rule (the item touches bl_* and skills/sprint): g2 the default FINISHED_ALIVE_GRACE_S (recommended 300 s), g3 which ops row records the stop (recommended agent.run, group stop-finished), g4 whether dispatch still ends the orphan processes after stopping a finished worker (recommended: no, only the recorded pid). They wait on the operator; work so far is on branch work/ST-zimb7vuu.
